descriptionChirho: To bring into existence by divine creative act, used exclusively of God's sovereign creation of the world, humanity, and new things (Qal active finite and infinitive forms).
Substantivized participle used as a divine title or epithet designating God as the one who creates, often in construct ('Creator of') or with possessive suffixes ('your Creator').
Passive of the Qal, denoting the state or event of being brought into existence by divine act, used of heavens, earth, peoples, and future things.
To cut down trees or clear forested land, a distinct Piel meaning unrelated to creation, used in contexts of clearing woodland for settlement or military destruction.
